feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: With one week until Election Day, a pollster shares how the election is shaping up
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with data journalist and pollster G. Elliott Morris about what he's seeing one week out from Election Day.

entry.title: DOJ attempting to prosecute former FBI Director James Comey for a third time
entry.summary: The Justice Department is attempting for a third time to bring criminal charges against ex-FBI director James Comey, a frequent critic of President Trump.

entry.title: Democrats still poised to make gains, but poll shows warning signs for just how many
entry.summary: Democrats hold significant advantages going into Election Day, according to a new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll. But lagging enthusiasm among key groups is just one indicator that gains may not come easy.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: A new NPR poll reveals Democrats' advantage going into Election Day, congressional Democrats are forming a task force to protect the election, Netanyahu vies for reelection as polls open in Israel.

entry.title: Comedian Zainab Johnson talks about her new special, 'Toxically Optimistic'
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with comedian Zainab Johnson about her new stand-up special on Netflix: "Toxically Optimistic."

entry.title: Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed makes final push to win over Black voters in Detroit
entry.summary: To win a seat in the Senate, Democratic candidate Abdul El-Sayed is making a final push to win over some Black Detroiters who are still skeptical of him.

entry.title: U.N. peacekeepers leaving Lebanon after pressure from U.S. and Israel
entry.summary: U.N. peacekeepers will leave Lebanon after nearly five decades, following U.S. and Israeli pressure.

entry.title: Some Michigan residents remain hopeful despite being hit hard by Trump's tariffs
entry.summary: Michigan households are paying the highest cost per household for the Trump administration's tariffs. For the voters paying the price, the issue isn't cut-and-dry.

entry.title: How congressional Democrats are preparing for claims of election fraud by Trump
entry.summary: Democrats in Congress are bracing for what they fear could be meddling by President Trump or his allies with the results of this year's midterm elections.

entry.title: Election security expert discusses the safeguards in place for the midterms
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with election security expert Lawrence Norden of the Brennan Center about efforts to undermine the midterm election and protections against fraud and intimidation.
